# Proficiency Level

An attained proficiency level on a scale (CEFR A1–C2; Dreyfus novice→expert; NIH beginner→expert; assessed; native; heritage). A value carried by gmeow:proficiencyLevel and gmeow:skillProficiencyLevel; gmeow:levelScale ties it to its scale. ILR (0–5) and ACTFL levels are added as further individuals.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProficiencyLevel>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`  

**Subclass of:** `gufo:QualityValue`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/expertise>
